{{Quests and Events|Yhan}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} Get in teams of two and we'll do another simulation battle.
:{{DIcon}} Perseverance is not the same as recklessness. Do you hear me?

:{{DIcon}} First, about weapon damage-
:{{DIcon}} Break time is over. All stand up! The training resumes. Attention!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Yhan:''' Hey, new guy. Care for some sparring? Necessary training will keep your mind sharp. Remember, you have no chance for mistakes out there.
----
:'''Yhan:''' Combat isn't just about strength. You need skills and wisdom too when facing enemies on the battlefield.
:{{DIcon|Attack}} Enter Simulation Training
::'''Yhan:''' You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Yhan:''' Greetings.
::{{DIcon}} What can you teach me?
::'''Yhan:''' Combat skills and tactics. Or anything you're willing to learn, as long as I have it.
::'''Yhan:''' Practicality is key on the battlefield. Years of combat have taught me that. If you want fancy tricks, go elsewhere.
::'''Yhan:''' I'll teach you how to surive, and how to win.
::{{DIcon}} Is surviving more important?
:::'''Yhan:''' Absolutely. But let me be clear, I am not condoning cowardice.
:::'''Yhan:''' I will give my life for Huanglong anytime, but I've also witnessed too many pointless deaths.
:::'''Yhan:''' I do not want to see our new recruits make the same mistakes. My purpose is to teach you how to avoid them and give you a better chance at life.
:::'''Yhan:''' Do not rush blindly into battle like those before you. You deserve more than that.
::{{DIcon}} Is winning more important?
:::'''Yhan:''' While winning is important, the battlefield is constantly changing.
:::'''Yhan:''' Avoid rushing for success and making costly mistakes. Focus on improving your skills and knowing what actions to take.
::'''Yhan:''' Remember, you have many years ahead of you. You should prioritize staying alive.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
